basic_info.description: 1043-45 Francisco a fully reimagined residence where world-class design meets San Francisco's most iconic views. This architectural sanctuary has been masterfully designed with stone and Cor-Ten steel. Guests are welcomed onto terrazzo floors and led upstairs to a breathtaking main level, where a linear fireplace and travertine walls anchor the living room and mahogany windows frame cinematic vistas of the Golden Gate Bridge, Palace of Fine Arts, Alcatraz, and Bay. The stylish kitchen pairs Calacatta marble surfaces with top-of-the-line appliances and a butler's pantry. Retractable glass sliding doors reveal stairs to a stunning view roof deck with fire pit and outdoor kitchen. The primary suite is a true retreat featuring a walk-in closet and spa-like bath w/steam shower, soaking tub, sauna, and outdoor shower. The entry level offers a bedroom/office with ensuite bath and garden access, media room, laundry, and bedroom suite. A seamlessly integrated guest suite with its own living room, kitchen and bridge views provides the ultimate in flexibility. A wine cellar, garden and 4-car parking (detached 2-car garage plus 2add'l) complete the picture. Nestled on a quiet street beside Francisco Park, this turn-key home offers serenity just steps from the vibrant Marina and North Beach.
